data.title: China Mobile: Buy Rating Maintained as Analyst Trims 12‑Month Target Price to HKD96 on Resilient Cash Flows and Growing Digital Services
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Andy Yu CFA from DBS maintained a Buy rating on China Mobile, with a price target of HK$96.00.

Andy Yu CFA has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with China Mobile’s entrenched leadership in both mobile and fixed-line broadband, which supports stable cash generation and cost advantages from network co-sharing. He also highlights the company’s successful pivot toward higher-margin digital services, where cloud, computing and AI-related revenues are expanding rapidly and now represent a meaningful share of its core business.

Despite near-term pressure from VAT reclassification and softer traditional connectivity growth, Andy Yu CFA views the financial profile as resilient, underpinned by strong net cash and industry-leading free cash flow. He maintains a Buy while trimming the 12‑month target price to HKD96, arguing that the valuation, based on an unchanged 14x blended FY26/27F PE, is attractive given the roughly 7% dividend yield, management’s commitment to “stable-to-rising” payouts, and China Mobile’s defensive earnings and cash flow characteristics.
